title: Studio services agreement
description: Fictional agreement for designing a printed event program.

clauses.title: Delivery
clauses.passage: The studio will deliver the first draft within five business days of receiving the final brief. Print-ready files are due two business days after written approval.
clauses.question: When are files due?
clauses.answer: The first draft is due within five business days of receiving the final brief. Print-ready files are due two business days after written approval.

clauses.title: Revisions
clauses.passage: The project includes two rounds of revisions. The client will send one consolidated set of comments per round.
clauses.question: How many revisions are included?
clauses.answer: Two rounds of revisions are included. The client should send one consolidated set of comments per round.

clauses.title: Approval
clauses.passage: The client will confirm final approval by email and include the approved version number in the message.
clauses.question: How is approval confirmed?
clauses.answer: The client confirms final approval by email and includes the approved version number in the message.
